title: WPMS/1708/2009 of SMT CHHINDO BAI Vs MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIM TRIBUNAL and OTHERS

paras.text: IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL

Writ Petition No. 1708 of 2009 (M/S)
[
Smt. Chhindo Bai
W/o late Ram Singh
R/o Village Barhaini, Tehsil Bajpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar.
 ................ Petitioner
 Versus
1. Motor Accident Claim Tribunal /
 District Judge, Udham Singh Nagar.
2. Jaspal Singh S/o Ranjit Singh
 R/o Village Bandia, Tehsil Kiccha
 District Udham Singh Nagar.
3. The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd.
 through Divisional Manager,
Haldwani, Nainital.
............... Respondents
Mr. Vishwa Deepak Bisen, Advocate for the petitioner.
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
2) By means of this writ petition, moved under
Article 226 read with Article 227 of the Constitution of
India, the petitioner has sought writ in the nature of
certiorari, quashing the order dated 26.08.2008, passed
by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal / District Judge,
Udham Singh Nagar, in Misc. (Release) Case No. 34 of
2009, whereby the said Tribunal has rejected the
application for release of Rs. 70,000/- deposited in

2
favour of the petitioner under order dated 01.08.2006,
passed by the Tribunal in M.A.C.P. Case No. 223 of
2004.
3) Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that
petitioner is a widowed lady in whose family the bread
earner Ram Singh (husband of the petitioner) died. The
claim petition was filed by the petitioner and her five
minor children. The Tribunal vide its order dated
01.08.2006, passed in M.A.C.P. Case No. 223 of 2004,
awarded Rs. 4,15,000/- as compensation, out of which
Rs. 60,000/- were kept in fixed deposit in favour of
each of the claimants No. 2 to 6 (minor children of the
deceased). Out of the remaining sum, an amount of
Rs. 70,000/- were directed to be kept in fixed deposit
for five years, payable to the widow (present
petitioner). Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that the family is in a dire need of the money
at this stage and atleast Rs. 70,000/-, which are
deposited in favour of the petitioner (widow of the
deceased) in fixed deposit should be released in her
favour so that she may meet the daily expenses and
educate the children till they attain age of majority. In
the above circumstances, the prayer of the petitioner
(widow of the deceased) appears to be genuine and it is
too harsh not to release even the amount which is not to
be paid to the minors.

3
4) Therefore, this writ petition is allowed. The
impugned order dated 26.08.2009, passed on
Application 4-C, in Misc. (Release) Application No. 34
of 2009, passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal
/ District Judge, Udham Singh Nagar, is quashed. Said
application shall stand allowed. The Tribunal shall
release the amount of Rs. 70,000/- deposited in the
fixed deposit in favour of the petitioner.
(Interim Relief Application No. 8652 of 2009 also
stands disposed of).
 [

(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)

Dt. October 08, 2009.
